# First Steps 

In this initial section, we will establish a basic working environment essential for any data related endeavor. 

You'll learn how to navigate your computer's command line, set up Python for the first time, and use the Anaconda distribution. 

Additionally, we'll guide you through using Jupyter Notebook, a powerful tool for interactive data exploration, and teach you the basics of Markdown to document your work effectively. 

Whether you're just starting out or refreshing your skills, these first steps will set you up for success as you continue to explore and analyze data.
